response.sql: SELECT p.ID, AVG(l.UA) AS avg_ua, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_hct FROM Patient AS p LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS r WHERE r.ID = p.ID AND r.RA = '-') GROUP BY p.ID ORDER BY avg_hct IS NULL, avg_hct DESC, p.ID ASC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Patients tied on average hematocrit are ordered by ID ascending to make the top 10 deterministic.
